# v1.3.0 - Enterprise Finance System with Complete Engineering and Design Rules
## Projects 27 v1.3.0: Enterprise Finance System with Complete Engineering and Design Rules

The merged Projects 23 engineering and Projects 24 design specification, applied to an enterprise finance reporting product with an API, a web app and iOS and Android clients.

### Key Highlights
- **Merged specification**: engineering rules and skills from Projects 23 with design, accessibility and front-end rules from Projects 24, plus rule 17 (financial integrity) and the `finance-reporting-systems` skill.
- **Text hygiene**: rule 18 and the skills `clean-user-facing-text`, `remove-ai-marks` and `content-hygiene` (zero-dependency Unicode scanner run in CI).
- **Product**: financial reporting architecture, API endpoints, capture evaluation and offline data storage on all three clients.
